text:
Nina (Partnerships): quick sync: exploring fractional-SKU mapping so HW + SI bundles can share a single private-offer while still attributing usage-based credits to sellers. want low-friction for sales and clean ledger for finance. thoughts?
Leo (Finance): sounds good. must ensure credits are traceable per SKU line item and have GL codes. prefer a waterfall credit model so primary HW seller gets first cut, then SI gets remainder. need explicit proration rules for mixed usage.
Kav (Eng-Billing): plumbing notes: marketplace private-offer supports custom line items but we need per-line usage hooks to emit usage events with seller_id. we can add an attribute on the private-offer payload: "seller_waterfall=[{seller:hw, pct:70},{seller:si, pct:30}]". ledger ticket INF-2890 created.
ops-bot: INF-2890 created - "per-line seller waterfall + usage attribution events" assigned to eng-billing.
Priya (Field): operational ask: onboarding milestone gating for SI credit release. propose two gates: A) SI deployment validation (automated smoke test), B) 30-day active usage >= X tokens. credits vested monthly but held in escrow until gate A.
Nina (Partnerships): sample waterfall rules i sketched:
````
waterfall_rules:
- primary_seller: hw_vendor_id
- secondary_seller: si_partner_id
- allocation: [70,30]
- upfront_accel: 7% of month1 (non-refundable) -> credited to SI after deployment validation
- activation_gate: smoke_test=true AND usage_30d >= threshold
- clawback: if activation_gate fails within 90d -> clawback secondary allocation only
- proration: if usage maps to only one SKU line -> allocate per waterfall ratios on consumed tokens
````
Leo (Finance): also need rules for returns/refunds and refunded usage. propose a negative-usage reversal window of 120d and a reconciliation monthly report with columns: offer_id, month, total_usage, hw_alloc, si_alloc, withheld_escrow, released_amount, clawback_amount.
Kav (Eng-Billing): agree. implementation plan: 1) extend usage event schema with offer_line_id and seller_tag, 2) ledger emits provisional entries at month-end while escrow flags hold until milestone signals, 3) reconciliation export endpoint for finance. I'll add RFC.
Priya (Field): can we surface a per-offer dashboard tile in Console that shows escrow state and next milestone ETA? helps AMs and sellers.
Nina (Partnerships): yes that will be helpful. owners: Nina -> final GTM wording and seller contract snippets; Leo -> reconciliation spec and GL mapping; Kav -> infra + RFC + INF-2890; Priya -> ops checklist and smoke test definition.
Kav (Eng-Billing): timeline ask: can we get a v1 with event schema + escrow flags in 3 sprints? need eng capacity. ops-bot: created subtask INF-2890-1 for schema.
ops-bot: INF-2890-1 created - "usage event schema + offer_line attribution".
Nina (Partnerships): customer-facing example private-offer payload (high level):
````
POST /private_offers
{
  "offer_id": "po-59384",
  "lines": [
    {"line_id":"l1","sku":"hw-1","price":50000,"seller":"hw_vendor_id"},
    {"line_id":"l2","sku":"si-onboarding","price":10000,"seller":"si_partner_id"}
  ],
  "seller_waterfall": [{"seller":"hw_vendor_id","pct":70},{"seller":"si_partner_id","pct":30}],
  "upfront_accel_pct": 7,
  "activation_gate": "smoke_test AND usage_30d>=X",
  "escrow_policy": "monthly_vesting_with_clawback_90d"
}
````
Priya (Field): nice. add note: include webhook destination for milestone events so SI can automate claim process.
Leo (Finance): +1. please ensure the payload includes vendor GL tags and partner legal entity id.
Nina (Partnerships): ok final ask: keep offer UX simple for sales. sales should see a single offer url that expands to show waterfall details. Priya will draft AM playbook for renewal outreach when usage approaches commit cliff.
Kav (Eng-Billing): will post RFC and mock events in #eng-billing by Fri.
Nina (Partnerships): target: internal pilot with 2 SI partners next month. owners acknowledged. thanks all. :rocket:
